verdict.rationale: GitHub documents a public REST API for creating integrations and automating workflows, plus a GraphQL API with full schema reference. Both have date-based versioning with advance notice of breaking changes, fine-grained token permissions, and stable, generally available OpenAPI descriptions in the github/rest-api-description repo. The probe's 404s at docs.github.com OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the specs are published in that repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
